g1_1_business.what_it_does: LUPIN Ltd is a pharmaceutical company that specializes in complex generics, including inhalation and injectable products, as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The company focuses on backward integration to enhance its manufacturing capabilities and product offerings. It generates revenue primarily through the sale of these pharmaceutical products in various markets, including India and the United States.

customers.description: Companies that distribute pharmaceutical products to healthcare providers.
Hospitals and clinics that purchase medications for patient care.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing of complex generics and APIs.

competitive_advantage: Expertise in complex generics that are difficult to replicate.
Established relationships with healthcare providers and distributors.
Diverse product portfolio across various therapeutic areas.
Strong financial health with net cash position.
